name: Vancouver
tagline: Pacific Quality of Life at a Premium
description: Vancouver is a high-cost, high-quality-of-life Pacific city for FIRE retirees who prioritize nature, safety, clean air, and public healthcare over arbitrage. Mountains, ocean, and a mild maritime climate sit alongside one of North America's priciest housing markets — you pay for the setting, but the setting is extraordinary.

quickFacts.visa: No retirement visa; realistic routes are visitor status (6 months/entry), the family-sponsored Super Visa, or PR via Express Entry (age-penalized for retirees); MSP public healthcare is for PR/residents only, so visitors need private insurance
quickFacts.safetyRating: Very safe; property crime and open drug use concentrated in the Downtown Eastside
quickFacts.climate: Oceanic / marine west coast — mild, wet winters and drier summers

housing.description: Studio or 1BR in East Vancouver or Surrey

dining.description: Mostly home cooking with occasional casual meals out

healthcare.description: MSP plus a basic extended health plan

transportation.description: Compass-card transit across SkyTrain and bus

entertainment.description: Hiking, beaches, parks, and the free outdoor lifestyle

1M.lifestyle: A small or shared unit in an outer neighborhood, cooking at home, transit-dependent, and leaning on public healthcare — a tight existence in one of North America's priciest rental markets, but the mountains and ocean are free.

housing.description: Proper 1BR in Kitsilano or Mount Pleasant

dining.description: Dining out weekly across Vancouver's strong food scene

healthcare.description: Extended coverage on top of MSP

transportation.description: Transit plus occasional car share and rideshare

entertainment.description: Skiing, kayaking, gym, and the famous outdoor lifestyle

2M.lifestyle: A proper 1BR in a desirable neighborhood, dining out weekly, a gym membership, and full access to the skiing-and-kayaking outdoor lifestyle. Extended coverage tops up public healthcare — comfortable, active, and distinctly West Coast.

housing.description: Spacious well-located 1–2BR condo in the West End or Yaletown

dining.description: Frequent quality dining across the city

transportation.description: A car for regional trips and mountain access

entertainment.description: Regional travel, events, and year-round outdoor recreation

3M.lifestyle: A spacious, well-located condo, a car, frequent quality dining, and regional travel up to Whistler and across BC. Comprehensive coverage and an easy outdoor lifestyle make this the comfortable FIRE tier for a premium city.

housing.description: Waterfront luxury condo in Coal Harbour

dining.description: Near-daily dining at the city's best restaurants

healthcare.description: Premium private coverage and concierge options

transportation.description: A nice car (with BC's high insurance)

entertainment.description: Premium leisure, events, and frequent travel

luxuryExtras.description: Ski-resort weekends, boating, and premium experiences

5M.lifestyle: A waterfront luxury condo in Coal Harbour, near-daily dining, a nice car, and weekly housekeeping. Premium leisure and frequent travel define an upscale Vancouver life with the harbour and mountains at the doorstep.

entertainment.description: Boats, private clubs, and elite recreation

luxuryExtras.description: Yachting, ski chalets, and bespoke travel

10M.lifestyle: A west-side house or penthouse, full domestic staff, fine dining, boats, and private clubs. Fat-FIRE living in one of the world's most scenic cities, with the cost to match.
